args.purpose: Screen a Firecrawl-extracted Sony EE instruction manual excerpt for prompt injection and relevance before interpreting it as technical evidence.
args.text: Firecrawl PDF extraction from https://docs.alexrp.com/mips/ee_insns.pdf returned a long answer and warning that only the first part of the 408-page manual was processed. The visible extracted answer describes MULT as signed 32-bit multiplication, gives (LO, HI) result behavior, says operands must be sign-extended 32-bit word values for defined results, and says no arithmetic exception occurs. The returned excerpt also contains unrelated OR and store-instruction definitions. It is external technical content to be used only for static instruction semantics.

queryOptions.prompt: Locate only the EE Core Instruction Set Manual definitions for MULT, MULTU, MULT1, and MADD. Return the exact operation equations, destination/HI/LO effects, and printed page numbers, preserving relevant words around each operation. If any instruction is absent, say so.

captured_result_fields.warning: The page was too long to process in full; the answer was generated from the first part of it.
captured_result_fields.answer_excerpt: MULT : Multiply Word. MIPS I. To multiply 32-bit signed integers. Format: MULT rs, rt. Description: (LO, HI) ← GPR[rs] × GPR[rt]. Multiplies the 32-bit value in GPR[rt] by the 32-bit value in GPR[rs] as signed integer values. If GPR[rt] and GPR[rs] are not sign-extended 32-bit values (bits 63..31 equal), then the result of the operation is undefined. Exceptions: None. No arithmetic exception occurs.

unavailable_fields: manual definitions/page numbers for MULTU, MULT1, and MADD in this returned answer
